templates.name: Godot 3D Base Template
templates.description: Modular 3D starter with seven controller modes (third-person, first-person, isometric, top-down, tank and others), scene transitions and configurable optional shooting. Suitable as an RPG/adventure foundation; does not supply a complete RPG system.

templates.name: Godot FPS Template
templates.description: Modular first-person shooter starter with movement, aim-down-sights, hitscan weapons, ammo, health, enemies, vehicles and a test level. Upstream describes it as work in progress.

templates.name: Horror FPS Template
templates.description: First-person horror starter with inventory, item use, crafting, draggable/lockable doors and drawers, ladders, elevators and a rechargeable night-vision camcorder.

templates.name: True First Person Multiplayer
templates.description: Multiplayer first-person starter using ENet with synchronized spawning, interpolation, walking/sprinting/jumping, air control, coyote time, jump buffering and menu/settings/pause UI.

templates.name: Kings and Pigs
templates.description: 2D fantasy action-platformer starter with terrain-aware tileset, hammer attacks, enter/exit doors, breakable boxes and heart/diamond counters. Stored under RPG as the closest requested category; it is not a complete RPG and needs additional enemies, UI and levels.

templates.name: COBRA FPS Feel Kit
templates.description: First-person movement and weapon-feel kit with view bob, recoil, hit feedback and switchable Twitchy/WW2/Arcade/Exploration profiles; includes FPS and magic/melee demo scenes.

templates.name: Third Person Shooter Template
templates.description: Third-person shooter starter by Chafmere: spring-arm camera with tweened shoulder switching and aim zoom, node-based state machine for combat and non-combat modes, AnimationTree-driven rigged character, component-based weapon manager with projectiles, ammo, pickups and dropping, and IK that keeps the player facing the camera. Itch comments report an import problem and broken weapon pickups.
templates.license: MIT code (Chaff Games, LICENCE.txt); Quaternius character CC0 per itch page; Kenney prototype textures CC0 (bundled License.txt)

templates.name: Kenney 3D Platformer Starter Kit
templates.description: Small 3D platformer kit by Kenney: player controller, coins, moving platforms, traps and a sample level. MIT licensed.

templates.name: Metroidvania System
templates.description: General-purpose metroidvania framework: room-based map, map UI, room transitions, collectible/progress tracking and example game. Framework, not a complete game.

templates.name: Slay the Robot
templates.description: Framework for roguelike deckbuilders in the style of Slay the Spire: cards, actions, enemies, relics, map and data-driven content.

templates.name: Quiver Tower Defense
templates.description: Tower defense game project: tower placement, enemy waves, pathing and upgrades. MIT licensed.

templates.name: Godot Open RTS
templates.description: Open source 3D RTS: unit selection and commands, resource gathering, building, fog-free combat and a skirmish AI.

templates.name: Nezvers Godot GameTemplate
templates.description: Top-down shooter template with weapons, enemies, pickups, menus and solutions for common game problems.

templates.name: Maaack Game Template
templates.description: Genre-neutral game scaffolding: main menu, options, pause menu, credits, scene loader, level flow and persisted settings.

templates.name: Vehicle Sample Racing
templates.description: Small Godot 4 racing sample with a drivable vehicle, track and lap flow. Minimal; expect to extend.

templates.name: Cat's Modular Souls-like Template
templates.description: Loosely coupled 3D souls-like template: third-person combat, lock-on, stamina, dodge and enemy components. Unlicense.
